result.reason: The operative language meets or improves on the preferred position: one audit per 12 months, 30 days’ written notice, during business hours, through an independent auditor subject to confidentiality, at HDI’s cost, with no systems access. However, the off-site requirement and prohibition on access to the Company’s “facilities” go beyond the playbook and are internally awkward: allowing off-site inspection only “to the extent reasonably practicable” implies possible on-site review, while the facilities-access prohibition appears to bar it entirely. References to remote access to facilities are also imprecise. These additions are not minimal, although unrelated commercial intent is preserved.
